htn_kidney.abstract: Forsythiae Fructus, a classic heat-clearing and detoxifying herb in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), is widely used for inflammatory conditions. Its primary bioactive component, Forsythoside A (FTA), exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. Given that hypertensive nephropathy is characterized by chronic inflammation, oxidative stress, and fibrosis-hallmarks that correspond to "heat" and "toxin" pathologies in TCM theory-Forsythiae Fructus represents a rational candidate for HN therapy. portal_hypertension.authors: Keitel V, Mentzinger A, Dröge C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：该英文报道关注最新动态：Completion of the human genome sequence, together with major technological advan... 临床提示：该英文报道关注最新动态：Human genetics has long been a cornerstone to elucidate the molecular basis of d...
portal_hypertension.abstract: Human genetics has long been a cornerstone to elucidate the molecular basis of disease. Completion of the human genome sequence, together with major technological advances, has dramatically reduced sequencing costs while increasing the scale, accuracy, and interpretability of genomic data. These developments have accelerated the clinical translation of genomic testing. Although genomic medicine has been most widely adopted in paediatrics, neurology, and oncology, its application in adult hepatology is expanding rapidly. This review synthesises the growing body of evidence supporting the use of genetic testing in the diagnosis and management of adults across a broad spectrum of liver diseases...
